translation.en: The tourists visited a great palace.
I saw a great city.
We looked at great mountains.
A painful illness afflicted the grandfather.

translation.bs: Smrt psa bila je bolna nesreća.
translation.en: The dog's death was a painful misfortune.
We lived through painful days.
We have little food.
There is little fruit in the house.
There are few houses in the village.
A capable man manages the factory.
The director is a capable woman.
There are capable women in the company.
The child found a dead bird.
The farmer cut down a dead tree.
The fishermen found dead whales.
We walked on a straight road.

translation.bs: U bašti je izraslo ravno drvo.
translation.en: A straight tree grew in the garden.
The workers stretched straight ropes.
A generous man was hospitable to us.
Our neighbor is a generous woman.
We stayed with generous men.

translation.bs: Nepažljiv čovjek je zaboravio svoj novac.
translation.en: An inattentive man forgot his money.

translation.bs: Nepažljiva žena zaboravila je svoj kofer.
translation.en: An inattentive woman forgot her suitcase.
The teacher advised inattentive children.

translation.bs: Doktor je otputovao u daleku zemlju.
translation.en: The doctor traveled to a distant country.

translation.bs: Moja tetka živi u dalekom selu.
translation.en: My aunt lives in a distant village.
The traveler visited distant countries.
The boy helped a blind man.
A blind woman reads with her fingers.
There are blind children in the school.
The newborn has a good name.
The neighbor said a good word.
The father chose good names.
The mother cooked good food.
The child ate a good fruit.
Our neighbors are good men.
A trustworthy man kept the money.
A trustworthy woman works in the store.
Trustworthy men guarded the treasure.
The police officer found a lost child.
The boy brought back a stray she-camel.

translation.bs: Policija je tragala za zalutalom djecom.
translation.en: The police searched for lost children.

translation.bs: Gluh čovjek je sjedio u džamiji.
translation.en: A deaf man sat in the mosque.
A deaf woman lives in the village.
Deaf men work in the market.

translation.bs: Sastali smo se na poznatom mjestu.
translation.en: We met in a known place.

translation.bs: Radnja se otvara u određeni sat.
translation.en: The store opens at a fixed hour.
These are known names.

translation.bs: Preselili smo se u novu kuću.
translation.en: We moved to a new house.
The carpenter built a new ship.
The school purchased new books.

translation.bs: Porodica se okupila na blagoslovljen dan.
translation.en: The family met on a blessed day.
We wish you a blessed year.

translation.bs: Proživjeli smo blagoslovljene dane s porodicom.
translation.en: We lived blessed days with our family.
In the room there is a luminous lamp.
We sat in a luminous room.

translation.bs: Vidjeli smo svijetle zvijezde na nebu.
translation.en: We saw luminous stars in the sky.
The worker carried a heavy load.
The ship transported heavy merchandise.
The student carried heavy books.
Do not believe this lying man.
A lying woman deceived the merchant.

translation.bs: Imam naše džamije je bogobojazan čovjek.
translation.en: The imam of our mosque is a pious man.

translation.bs: Moj brat se oženio bogobojaznom ženom.
translation.en: My brother married a pious woman.
Pious men pray in the mosque.

translation.bs: Na putu smo vidjeli nesretnog čovjeka.
translation.en: We saw a wretched man on the road.
The neighbor fed a wretched woman.
Wretched men live in the city.

translation.bs: Sjećamo se slavnog dana iz naše historije.
translation.en: We remember a glorious day from our history.
We studied the history of a glorious nation.
The city lived through glorious days.

translation.bs: Vidio sam dijete uskraćeno za hranu.
translation.en: I saw a child deprived of food.
We gave a deprived woman food.

translation.bs: Opčinjeni čovjek gledao je u planinu.
translation.en: The bewitched man looked at the mountain.

translation.bs: Jedna opčinjena žena sjedila je kraj mora.
translation.en: A bewitched woman sat by the sea.

translation.bs: Opčinjeni muškarci stajali su pred morem.
translation.en: Bewitched men stood in front of the sea.
The child found a hidden treasure.
In the house there is a hidden room.
In the sea there are hidden treasures.

translation.bs: U selu je živio jedan prezren čovjek.
translation.en: A despised man lived in the village.

translation.bs: Jedna prezrena žena živjela je sama.
translation.en: A despised woman lived alone.

translation.bs: Laž i krađa su prezrena djela.
translation.en: Lying and theft are despised actions.

translation.bs: Moj otac je prodao debelo tele.
translation.en: My father sold the fat calf.
The neighbor purchased the fat ewe.
The merchant purchased the fat cows.
We waited for the absent brother.

translation.bs: Majka je pitala za odsutnu sestru.
translation.en: The mother asked about the absent sister.

translation.bs: Odsutna braća vratila su se u kuću.
translation.en: The absent brothers returned to the house.
People do not like the conceited man.

translation.bs: Jedna uobražena žena ušla je na pijacu.
translation.en: A conceited woman entered the market.

translation.bs: Na pijaci su sjedili uobraženi muškarci.
translation.en: Conceited men sat in the market.
In the house there is a secret door.

translation.bs: Dijete je ušlo u tajnu sobu.
translation.en: The child entered a secret room.
The city has secret gates.
The mother purchased the fresh meat.
The child ate a fresh fruit.
The father advised the disobedient child.
The neighbor has a disobedient daughter.
The mother advised the disobedient daughters.
The man lived a pure life.
Pure souls love the good.
We entered from the eastern gate.
We traveled to an eastern city.
The merchant visited eastern countries.
We walked on a broad road.

translation.bs: Ukrcali smo se na široku lađu.
translation.en: We boarded a broad ship.

translation.bs: U ovoj zemlji ima širokih rijeka.
translation.en: In this country there are broad rivers.
The guard stands at the western gate.

translation.bs: Moj brat je posjetio zapadni grad.
translation.en: My brother visited a western city.
The merchants travel to western countries.

translation.bs: Čovjek je živio u udaljenoj zemlji.
translation.en: The man lived in a remote country.

translation.bs: Doktor je stigao u udaljeno selo.
translation.en: The doctor reached a remote village.
We saw remote mountains.
